name: pmcro-csuite
description: Consolidated C-suite plugin: 12 Chief persona agents plus 2 parameterized command skills. Merges the former 12 pmcro-chief-* plugins into one package; govern-<domain>-intent and select-reasoning-strategy are now single skills taking chief_id as an arg instead of 12 near-duplicate copies.

metadata.omode_note: omode/<id>.yaml files referenced by earlier design docs are not present in this plugin directory as of this writing

notes: Chiefs may [govern-domain-intent, select-reasoning-strategy]; mayNot [execute-provider-action, seal-cycle, issue-disposition, rewrite-laws].
Governed by L-EVIDENCE, L-CHECKER-GATE, L-PLUGIN-ISOLATION, L-OUTPUT-CONTRACT.
Agents auto-discovered from agents/; skills auto-discovered from skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
